items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I know Baby Dodds in Chicago had one of them. He showed it to me years ago.

ctx.x: He said, that's a slapstick. I bought it, you know? Oh, Mr. Bill, that must have been wrong when in the 30s. The old time drummers used to use them.
I know Baby Dodds in Chicago had one of them. He showed it to me years ago. Yeah.
